title: Single-Menu XR, 3D Mascot & Gesture Feedback · v0.9.0
changes: Source-image EXTRACT button now has a correct top-left XR hit target; image X hides, image ··· opens exactly one vertical context menu.
Context menu offers Restore (paid single click), Prompt (Quest keyboard / Enter to send), Voice and 3D; redundant Mix, Folder and Bin floating bars removed.
Optional 3D shaded WebGL mascot, 2D sprite or Off; animated blinking/emotions with pointer-side tracking and bounded simulated idle bounce.
Local debounced hand-joint classifier for OK, thumbs up/down, pointing, forward, fist, open palm and two-hand heart; spoken feedback opt-in.
Voice status floats near line of sight, with red listening indicator, transcription dots and recognized text; restores speech results in the XR scene.
3D jobs use Meshy opt-in confirmation and existing stored job status, then continue polling without holding the XR render loop.
Watcher v0.9.0 in this ZIP: ANSI green success/red error, blank lines between releases and silent archiving of old ZIPs.
No physical Quest test or real model charges performed; preserve profiles, private objects, vault and budget configurations.
